scheduled_service_proxy.limitation: Only days with matched ticket observations and scheduled crossings. Timing depends on the training method; scheduled service may differ from actual service.

all_scheduled_days_proxy.assumption: Days with scheduled service but no matched ticket observations are counted as zero observed tickets; incomplete ticket coverage can bias this value.

relative_crowding.label: typical
relative_crowding.comparison: same route, directed segment and day type across hours
relative_crowding.limitation: Ticket-sample pressure per scheduled crossing; not actual crowding, occupancy, or a cross-route comparison. Thresholds are not yet validated; Saturday and Sunday use at most three training days, and Sunday has no tuning evidence.

schedule_alignment.interpretation: Matched ticket sample for this route, directed segment, hour and day type during training; schedule mismatch may reflect timing or service differences. Not a share of all riders.

body.definition: Mean ticket-sample passenger crossings on days with at least one matched ticket. Not occupancy or per-bus load. Timing: observed ticket-sample passenger journeys crossing a segment, grouped by ticket boarding hour

training.definition: observed ticket-sample passenger journeys crossing a segment, grouped by ticket boarding hour
